cases.task: In PocketFlow, Node and AsyncNode accept invalid retry wait values that may fail only after execution starts or produce an invalid delay. At construction, require wait to be a finite non-negative int or float; reject bool and non-numbers with TypeError mentioning wait, and reject negative or non-finite numbers with ValueError mentioning wait. Preserve zero and positive finite values. Add tests in tests/test_wait_validation.py and run the repository tests.
